textPlacement.assessment: Renewed pass on the complete current Connection & feelings row and detail, including age/context and references. “Working out a disagreement together” identifies the situation, and the first paragraph supplies Davies’s concrete preverbal example of offering a crawling sibling another toy. The example is presented as hers, not a required child response. The short summary keeps the adult supplying most possibilities; the body retains adult leadership, necessary limits, revisiting an unhelpful plan, moderate note use and immediate protection. The 18–24-month placement is a browsing context, with no fluent-speech or independent-problem-solving deadline. TL-TONE-004 is resolved in this exact replacement.

Renewed pass on the complete current Connection & feelings row and detail, including the visible book references. The summary now conditions amends on someone being hurt or something being damaged, so a tantrum or disappointment alone does not become something to repair. It keeps calm before discussion, available comfort, declined touch and everyone’s safety. The body still describes possible triggers without diagnosing a child or promising prevention, and retains public-space and necessary-departure conditions. The locator now names recognizable book subjects. No mandatory cuddle, calm-place routine, child deadline or demand for perfect parental calm was added. TL-TONE-001 and TL-TONE-002 are resolved in this exact replacement.

Renewed pass on both the Connection & feelings and Play & discovery rows and the complete detail/age/reference context. The final sentence describes possible outlets while the adult observes, removing the assumption about the child’s sought movement. The short summary continues to combine observation, protection and an outlet; the body retains the explicit wooden-object caution, moving vulnerable objects and the outdoor/soft-indoor distinction. The title identifies throwing, and the attributed perspective does not become a material-safety approval, behavior diagnosis or promised end to a phase. TL-TONE-003 is resolved in this exact replacement.
